# Packages whose tests deliberately install the Lean-verified PQ cores through
# dregg-pq-testkit. The macOS CI runner has no published Darwin-arm64 Lean seed,
# so executing these tests would fail closed before their first PQ operation.
#
# scripts/ci-macos-marshal-packages.py derives the actual direct dev-dependency
# set from Cargo metadata and requires it to match this reviewed manifest. Adding
# or removing a testkit edge therefore changes CI only through an explicit diff.
